conclusion: 今日主线是: AI 工作台进入“迁移周”。Codex 侧最紧急的是 2026-08-31 的 GPT-5.4/GPT-5.4 mini 退场，所有工作区默认模型、自动化、custom agents 和 scheduled tasks 都要做一次冻结清单；OpenAI Work/Codex 正在把浏览器、Site tools(WebMCP)、云浏览器登录、插件市场、Apple Messages 和事件触发任务接成一个跨 app 工作面；GitHub Copilot 同步把 cloud agent、github.com Chat 和 GitHub Mobile 拉向统一策略，并把代码审查扩展到 bot PR 和超大 PR；Claude Code hooks 与 Cato 假 Codex 下载事件提醒我们，代理越能持续运行，越要给模型、插件、下载入口、hook、PR 审查和外部发送建立可审计闸门。
excerpt: 2026-08-29 的重点是先补模型迁移、会话策略、插件自动更新和安装命令四类闸门。
今天的判断很明确: agent 能跨端、跨 app、跨 PR 工作后，默认值和证据链比单个按钮更重要。

signals.title: GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini retire from Codex on August 31
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT & Codex changelog
signals.summary: Codex users signed in with ChatGPT need to replace GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini before the August 31 cutoff.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 建 Model Migration Freeze List，扫默认模型、自动化、custom agents 和 scheduled tasks。

signals.title: Work with more websites in ChatGPT Work and Codex
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Local browser, Site tools(WebMCP), and cloud browser sign-in now need separate evidence and permission handling.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 每个网页任务先声明 lane、允许动作、读回方法、账号边界和停止条件。

signals.title: Scheduled tasks can respond to app updates and be shared
signals.author: OpenAI Help Center
signals.summary: Work scheduled tasks can respond to Gmail, Slack, and GitHub events and be shared as independent workspace copies.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 给事件任务写 Trigger Envelope，包含 source、payload、idempotency、owner 和重复事件策略。

signals.title: Import and sync plugin marketplaces from GitHub
signals.author: OpenAI Help Center
signals.summary: Admins can import plugin marketplaces from GitHub and keep plugins synchronized daily without automatically granting app access.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 上 Marketplace Auto-Update Gate，记录来源仓库、allowlist、权限 diff 和回滚。

signals.title: Use Apple Messages from Codex and ChatGPT Work
signals.author: OpenAI Help Center
signals.summary: Apple Messages connects Work/Codex to real message reading, drafting, and sending on Apple silicon Macs.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 把 read/search、draft、recipient confirmation、send approval 和 post-send evidence 分成五个 gate。

signals.title: ChatGPT release notes add active sessions and Codex Windows Computer Use
signals.author: OpenAI Help Center
signals.summary: Session visibility, app-directory wording, Windows Computer Use, and mobile/Mac steering reinforce explicit host-vs-control roles.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 建 Agent Session Policy Matrix，写清 host device、control device 和完成证据。

signals.title: Copilot cloud agent, github.com Chat and GitHub Mobile converge into one policy
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: GitHub plans a single policy for cloud agent, github.com Chat, and Mobile, with retention and default enablement changes.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 在切换前审查默认开启、保留期、sandbox、移动端访问和 opt-out 后果。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot code review default changes toward Balanced effort
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Copilot code review Default effort will move from Lite to Balanced unless organizations or repositories pin a different value.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 对关键仓库显式 pin review effort，避免默认值改变成本和审查深度。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases - August 24
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Copilot added shared team sessions, Customize tab, CLI default modes, session restore, cross-agent continuity, and model usage visibility.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 对 agent workbench 记录 defaultMode、permission mode、restore、plugin/MCP surface 和 usage。

signals.title: Copilot code review expands to bot-authored and very large pull requests
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Copilot code review can now handle bot-authored PRs, cloud-agent PRs, and PRs beyond previous file/line limits.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 对 AI-authored PR 增加 Author/Reviewer Independence Gate 和 resolution reason。

signals.title: Enterprise-managed settings now support autoUpdate for plugin marketplaces
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Managed settings can auto-update plugin marketplaces while still requiring sources to be permitted by strictKnownMarketplaces.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 把 autoUpdate 当部署通道管理，保留 allowlist、diff、禁用和回滚。

signals.title: Global model policy generally available for GitHub Copilot
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: New and unconfigured models can delegate to a global policy unless explicitly enabled or disabled.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 维护 Model Policy Matrix，分 enabled、disabled、inherited、delegate-to-default 四种状态。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 hardens guardrails and usage accounting
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The SDK redacts blocked tool outputs, raises terminal failed/incomplete responses, and isolates usage accounting between checkpoints.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 升级前补 redaction、terminal failure、provider config 和 usage checkpoint 测试。

signals.title: Claude Code hooks reference documents lifecycle audit points
signals.author: Anthropic Docs
signals.summary: The hook reference describes prompt, tool, permission, compaction, config, stop and failure events that can inspire cross-agent audit design.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 把自家 agent 栈映射到 pre-tool、post-tool、permission、config-change 和 stop-failure 审计点。

signals.title: Fake Codex ClickFix campaign targets macOS developers
signals.author: Cato CTRL
signals.summary: Attackers impersonated Codex through search ads and Google Sites, pushing macOS developers toward terminal-command malware delivery.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 建 ClickFix Install Guardrail，只信官方来源并审查复制到终端的命令。

signals.title: AI-to-AI Code Reviews of GitHub Pull Requests
signals.author: Niruthiha Selvanayagam and Taher A. Ghaleb / arXiv
signals.summary: Closed-loop AI review is increasing but remains a minority of identified agent activity, with reviewer output varying by product pairing.
signals.takeaway: 动作: AI 写、AI 审的 PR 要加独立性检查，不能把同厂自审当作完整质量保证。

knowledge.title: Model Migration Freeze List
knowledge.summary: 在模型退场或默认模型切换前，把所有会引用旧模型的位置冻结成清单，逐项迁移并验收。
knowledge.usage: 用于 Codex 模型退场、Copilot global model policy、团队托管配置、自动化任务、custom agents、CI agent。

knowledge.title: Agent Session Policy Matrix
knowledge.summary: 对每条 agent 会话记录入口、执行面、保留期、权限继承、默认 effort、移动端可见性和最终验收责任。
knowledge.usage: 用于 Codex、ChatGPT Work、Copilot cloud agent、GitHub Mobile、Slack/Teams agent session、长会话换车。

knowledge.title: Marketplace Auto-Update Gate
knowledge.summary: 插件市场可以自动同步时，先把上架清单、版本、权限、审计和回滚写成门禁，而不是让插件静默变更。
knowledge.usage: 用于 GitHub Copilot extraKnownMarketplaces、ChatGPT Business 插件 marketplace、Codex plugins、内部 skill/catalog 分发。

knowledge.title: ClickFix Install Guardrail
knowledge.summary: 任何要求复制命令到 Terminal/PowerShell 的安装说明，都先经过来源、域名、命令、包名和副作用审查。
knowledge.usage: 用于 Codex CLI、Claude Code、MCP server、开源 agent 工具、curl pipe shell、公司 onboarding。
